content.short: Esprito Protocol is a TON security-layer project for safer blockchain interactions and protective tooling.
content.description: Esprito Protocol focuses on TON security infrastructure. The project presents itself as a security layer for the TON blockchain, making it relevant for teams and users that need safer interactions, checks, or protective tooling around TON activity. Esprito Protocol is a security layer for TON blockchain. Our advanced scam detection tools automatically scan TON smart contracts, alerting users to high-risk transactions and safeguarding them from potential fraud. Esprito Protocol matters because TON teams need review, monitoring, fraud checks, or safer launch processes before real users and funds are exposed.
